newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Ward tells factors sees wider loss - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Ward tells factors sees wider loss - WSJ.

text.p: Privately-held U.S. retailer Montgomery Ward told factors its first and second quarter losses would be much higher than it previously thought, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
Factors insure the receivables of suppliers, it said.
Montgomery Ward said in a letter sent to factors last week that it would report a $140 million loss in the first quarter, above a previously forecast $41 million loss, the paper said.
For the second quarter, it said it would have a projected loss of $108 million, compared to a previous forecast of an $18 million loss, the newspaper said, quoting factors.
The company, which was not immediately available, declined to comment in the Journal.
